Gf.bar_b_note: A's large wrapped recipe text and labelled Craft/Leave hints carry legibility, but the hint glyphs are tiny keyboard icons rather than teal controller prompts, and B's clipped micro-text and 'Craft: A / Enter' footnote sink it below shipping finish.

Gl.bar_b_note: The naturalistic spotted gecko with amber frills reads well in standing and swimming, but rust-brown tones remain at the frill bases and a stretched rod-like tail in faint end looks broken.

Ui.bar_b_note: The blue-violet salamander has a pleasant palette, but it is low and long, barely taller than the trainer, and its surface reads as smooth gloss rather than authored scale detail.

Uz.bar_b_note: The dark wolf with blue storm accents is close to the Tanglevolt bar and stands well above the trainer, but its near-black values merge with the dark stage, and stray particles float above the faint frames.

Ew.bar_b_note: A's timber frame, diagonal brace, plank cap and separate stone footing make a believable wall, though the infill is still a flat cream plane; B's blown-out white card with no cap or footing, plus the flat sky and sparse meadow, sink both below Palworld finish.

Wx.bar_b_note: This is the same gecko as Gl, with readable naturalistic patterning and amber frills, but the faint-end tail stretches into a dark rust rod and the frill roots still lean toward dark red.

Bm.bar_b_note: The busy yellow-black camouflage breaks up the spiky toad silhouette, so face, limbs and spines turn to mush at small size, and the creature is only modestly taller than the trainer.

Od.bar_b_note: B's fluffy white-and-blue fur reaches toward the naturalistic bar, though its faint end curls into an ambiguous sitting blob; A reads as smooth plastic, and its faint end breaks into black limb gaps and grey chunks.

Ru.bar_b_note: The warm grandfather villager with expressive eyes and a green-and-brown earthy palette fits the key art's settlement folk, but the face is a touch more cartoon-glossy than the world around it.

Oy.bar_b_note: The cyan spotted water dragon with a pale belly has a clear, appealing silhouette and a working ridden pose, but the crest and frills are warm red-orange that still sits near the reserved red, and the faint end flattens into a stiff plank.

Dc.bar_b_note: This is the same cyan dragon as Oy, readable and on-palette in the body, with red-orange crest edges and a rigid, plank-like faint end holding it back.

top_changes.change: Recolour every frill, fin and crest still in rust or red-orange (gecko Gl/Wx, cyan dragon Oy/Dc) to amber, gold, teal or white, so no friendly creature carries the enemy-faction red
Fix the broken faint-end poses: the gecko's stretched tail rod, the cyan dragon's rigid plank, Od A's black limb gaps and Od B's ambiguous curl; settle them into grounded side-lying poses

Ship the larger craft-panel layout (A) with teal controller-glyph prompts (A Craft / B Leave) at full size, and keep the homestead wall's framed, capped, stone-footed build with a textured wattle or plank infill instead of a flat cream plane
